en: Black‑and‑white image showing a large rectangular three‑storey masonry building with a raised basement, classical detailing around the corners and windows, and a small decorative emblem on the facade. The structure stands slightly elevated above a landscaped area with grass, flower beds, and a low metal railing. A curving path leads past the front entrance into a tree‑lined promenade or park that runs along the left side of the image. The scene is quiet, with no clear signage or modern vehicles, suggesting an early 20th‑century urban or small‑town European setting.
